column2: [intro]
At the toy library, I found my delight,
A plastic drum, it was my first love's light,
I played non-stop, with fervor and zeal,
My whole neighborhood knew my drumming appeal.
I took a plastic drum from the toy library,
And I drummed, drummed, drummed, all through the day,
In my child’s heart, I was a rock star on display,
Rubber drums, my rhythm made quite a play.
The neighbors got restless, my parents would scold,
But the plastic drum had me under its hold,
I pictured myself on stage, crowd in cheer,
Rock’n’roll in pajamas, a mini Mick Jagger here.
I took a plastic drum from the toy library,
And I drummed, drummed, drummed, all through the day,
In my child’s heart, I was a rock star on display,
Rubber drums, my rhythm made quite a play.
